title: Presentation Slide Url Sync
summary:
German presentations now use German bookmark values in the URL, not just German query keys.

- Added optional `name` on Sequence, Thought, and Arrangement (URL-only; never rendered).
- `presentationEntityBookmarkName()` resolves `name ?? id` for URL values.
- `intro({ language: "de" })` assigns German bookmark names (haupt, einleitung, titel, beschreibung, ziel, autoren, zugehoerigkeiten-*).
- Projektetage media thought/slides use German names (medien, katalog, katalog-fokus, katalog-beschriftungen, medien-suite).

German URL example: `#/?sequenz=haupt&gedanke=einleitung&folie=titel`. All core (34) and renderer (18) tests pass.
